BiblicalUsage: Medan is a son of Abraham by Keturah, named with his brothers Zimran, Jokshan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. He is named again in the genealogy of the nations in Chronicles.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the sons of Keturah are the loose ends of Abraham's story: they were given gifts and sent away eastward, and their names are kept even though the promise went through Isaac.
